messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: alert 'prometheus_scrape_failures_high' fired for 'prod-cluster' (5+ scrape failures). Triggered targets: node-exporter (3), app-metrics (2), logging-sidecar (7). Pager: @Alex G.

Alex G: Acked. Looking.

Mira S: I’m seeing a matching Grafana alert: 'logging_ingestion_lag > 5m' for the logging pipeline (vector->loki). Dash shows ingestion lag spiking ~00:03 UTC.

Jonathan K: Confirming Prom targets: `curl -s http://prometheus-prod:9090/api/v1/targets?state=down | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | select(.labels.job=="logging-sidecar")'` returns multiple 5xx/timeout entries.

Sam T: Also seeing increased CPU on the logging aggregator pods (logging/vec-aggregator) - top shows process stuck in GC loop. Might be backpressure causing sidecars to time out.

Leila P: Any customer impact? Are any API SLOs failing or just internal metrics?

Alex G: Early triage: metrics scraping failing for logging-sidecar and node-exporter intermittently. Prom scrape failures cause alerting + missing metrics in dashboards. Logging ingestion lag means logs are delayed ~4-12 minutes for some tenants — likely delayed but not lost. Customer-facing APIs still green from traffic side.

PagerDuty: escalation to @Mira S (infra lead) after 5m of no-resolve.

Mira S: I’m going to scale the vector aggregator to 4 -> 8 replicas and restart the vector daemonset on each node to flush backpressure. Will run rolling restart.

Alex G: Commands I ran:
```
# check failed targets
kubectl -n monitoring exec -it deploy/prometheus -- curl -s localhost:9090/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | {scrapeUrl: .scrapeUrl, lastError: .lastError}' | grep -A1 logging-sidecar
# scale aggregator
kubectl -n logging scale deploy/vec-aggregator --replicas=8
# rollout restart
kubectl -n logging rollout restart daemonset/vector-sidecar
```

Jonathan K: Logs from vec-aggregator show repeated `error flushing batch: connection reset by peer` and `channel full` messages. Increasing replicas should help. Also bumping memoryLimit to 2Gi on the deployment might avoid churn.

Sam T: I’ve applied the replica change and a quick memory bump to staging then prod. Rolling restart started. Watching health.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: @Alex G acknowledged. @Mira S escalated.

Leila P: I’m updating the status page: "Partial logging ingestion delay for a subset of customers. No active API degradation. Engineers investigating." Anyone object?

Mira S: Good. Please add note about Prometheus missing metrics and that alerts may be noisy.

Leila P: Added.

Alex G: After the scale and restarts, Prometheus target failures dropped from 7 -> 1 in ~90s. Ingestion lag falling from 8m peak to ~1m in latest graphs.

Mira S: Nice. I’m going to keep this incident open for 30m to confirm stability, then will handoff if stable. Creating a concise summary for the on-call handoff.

Alex G: Summary (for handoff):
- Incident id: PD#1427 / internal thread ts 1710001234
- Symptoms: prometheus scrape failures for logging-sidecar + node-exporter; Grafana alert for logging ingestion lag >5m.
- Impact: Logs delayed ~4-12m for a subset of tenants; alert noise from missing metrics; no customer API errors observed.
- Root cause (suspected): vector aggregator resource exhaustion (GC/backpressure) causing sidecar timeouts and Prom scrape failures.
- Actions taken: scaled vec-aggregator 4->8, bumped memory limit, rolled vector daemonset restart, monitored Prom targets and Grafana.
- Current state: Prom failures down to 1, ingestion lag ~1m and trending down.
- Next steps: monitor for 30m; run a postmortem if reoccurs; consider permanent autoscaling and memory limit increase.

Mira S: Sounds good. Handing to @Jonathan K for the next 30m watch. If it re-fires, escalate to eng-infra channel and open an incident doc.

Jonathan K: Taking handoff. I’ll check back at +15m and +30m with metrics snapshot.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff recorded — previous: Alex G, current: Jonathan K.

Sam T: Quick followup that might be a workaround long-term: introduce circuit-breaker/backpressure at sidecar level to shed non-critical logs under high pressure (we should eval).

Leila P: Filing a follow-up ticket for post-incident changes (autoscale rules, memory bump, backpressure strategy, runbook updates). Ticket: INC-logs-20260314-1.

Alex G: Closing PagerDuty alert once stable. I’ll keep thread open until Jonathan confirms 30m stable.

Jonathan K: Confirmed stable at +30m. No new scrape failures, ingestion lag <2m. I’m marking the incident as resolved in PagerDuty and updating the ticket with graphs and commands executed.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert 'prometheus_scrape_failures_high' resolved.

Leila P: Thanks all — follow-up actions assigned in INC-logs-20260314-1.

Alex G: Great work. Feel free to ping me if the postmortem needs anything from SRE side. :thumbsup:
